name: B Orlando Automotive Supplies & Equipment
old_description: B. Orlando Co. LLC is an auto body distributor in Philadelphia, Pa. providing automotive supplies and equipment to the Philadelphia, Bucks County and South Jersey areas.
about:
B. Orlando Co. LLC operates as an auto body distributor from its location at 8358-60 Hegerman Street in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company serves customers across Philadelphia, Bucks County, and South Jersey, positioning itself as a local source for collision repair and refinishing professionals.

The business supplies automotive paint, body shop equipment, and related materials to independent auto body shops and repair facilities throughout the greater Philadelphia region. It maintains regular business hours Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, offering walk-in and call-in access to inventory.

Its customer base consists primarily of independent auto body shops, collision centers, and automotive refinishing businesses in the tri-state area. The distributor focuses on providing the supplies and equipment needed for day-to-day repair operations, from consumables to larger shop equipment.

The company’s website notes a mission statement planned for summer 2025, but no specific founding rationale, ownership history, or competitive differentiation is publicly detailed beyond its role as a regional distributor.
